DELIVERABLES:
1. shared/adapter.js: pure functions parseRegistryFile, parseTranscriptLine, parseSubagentMeta as in CONTRACTS §3, emitting AdapterEvent objects. Must handle the real fixture files exactly; unknown record types and missing fields produce `drift` events, never exceptions. Extract `args` (≤120 chars summary of tool input) and `paths` via shared/paths.js. Detect agent_spawn from the Agent tool_use plus the following tool_result whose toolUseResult has agentId (fixture parent/excerpt.jsonl shows both). ctxUsed per CONTRACTS §3. Works in Node and in a browser (no Node imports).
2. shared/paths.js: extract file paths from tool inputs (Read/Edit/Write/MultiEdit file_path, NotebookEdit notebook_path, Grep/Glob path and pattern, Bash command tokens that look like paths or end in a known extension). Normalise ~ and absolute paths to a short display form relative to cwd or ~ when possible.
3. server/registry.js + tailer.js: poll ~/.claude/sessions/*.json every poll_ms; identity by sessionId (a resumed session gets a new pid file, old file removed; keep the Session, update pid). Locate the transcript at <data_root>/projects/<slug>/<sessionId>.jsonl where slug is cwd with path separators and dots replaced by '-' (verify against the fixture registry cwd → the real folder name -Users-john-Documents-GitHub-agent-workspace). Tail transcripts reading only appended bytes, handle partial last lines, file truncation/rotation, and 40 MB files at startup (read the whole file once in streaming fashion but only keep derived state; do not hold the file in memory). Discover <sessionId>/subagents/agent-*.jsonl and .meta.json as they appear and tail them with agentId context. Liveness: pid alive via platform.js when native; file freshness (stale_after_s) when data_root is not the local home or when running in docker (env AGENTDECK_MODE=docker).
4. server/state.js: applies AdapterEvents into the Snapshot (sessions, agents, huddles, alerts, feed capped 500/session). Derive: lead agent per session; agent state machine (working when a tool_call has no result yet, thinking when an assistant_turn has text but no tool, idle when the last record is a completed assistant turn with no pending tool for the lead, waiting when a hook PermissionRequest arrived for that session and no matching tool_result yet, done/removed for subagents after their transcript's final result or agent_end, compacting on the compaction event). Huddles per CONTRACTS §3 (same assistant message id). Alerts: approval (from hooks), context (ctxUsed/ctxLimit ≥ context_warn_pct), conflict (same path edited by agents in two different huddles or by two agents), drift, stale. Emit StreamEvents on an internal event bus.
5. server/sse.js + http.js: GET /events (snapshot on connect, deltas, heartbeat snapshot every 30 s), GET /api/state, GET /api/health, POST /hook/:event (accept JSON body up to 64 KB, treat as untrusted data, map PermissionRequest → waiting; SubagentStart/Stop, PreCompact, Notification, Stop → corresponding events), GET /control → 501 {disabled:true} when controls_enabled is false, static files from web/ and themes/ with correct MIME types (html, js, css, json, png, svg). No directory listing.
6. server/config.js + platform.js: defaults from CONTRACTS §8, load agentdeck.json from cwd then ~/.config/agentdeck/, flags override. Per-OS data_root default (macOS/Linux ~/.claude, Windows %USERPROFILE%\.claude, detect WSL via /proc/version and support a \\wsl$ path when given). pid alive: process.kill(pid,0) on POSIX; on Windows use tasklist via child_process with a short timeout.
7. server/log.js: leveled logger to stderr plus rotating file ~/.config/agentdeck/agentdeck.log (5 MB, keep 3). server/hooks.js: --print-hooks prints the JSON snippet for PermissionRequest, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, Notification, Stop, each `curl -s --max-time 0.3 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:<port>/hook/<Event> --data-binary @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true`; --install-hooks merges into ~/.claude/settings.json arrays (append, never replace existing hooks) with diff + backup + confirmation.
8. server/demo.js + tools/make-demo.mjs: --demo serves fixtures/demo.jsonl (lines {t, type, data} of StreamEvents) on a timeline, looping every 125 s, so the UI runs without Claude Code; --replay <file> plays a recorded transcript through the adapter at 20× speed. make-demo.mjs must generate a sequence mirroring mockup F: three sessions (agent workspace busy with lead + Explore hooks + Explore registry + Builder waiting + Architect done; jenkins-c0 waiting on Edit; harness idle), tool rotations every ~2-4 s, lead alternating thinking/working every 9 s, Builder approval granted at 21 s then a new approval, a subagent finishing and leaving every 30 s with a newcomer, huddle batches at 5 s (3 members), 22 s (2), 42 s (2) with members that touch overlapping paths including two editing server.py and ~/.claude/settings.json, reports back after 30-50 s, lead context climbing from 31% to trigger the 85% alarm around 60-80 s and compaction at 96%.
9. server.js: CLI (flags in CONTRACTS §8), startup checks with plain-English messages (data root missing, port in use, Node too old), open browser unless --no-open (macOS open, Linux xdg-open, Windows start), prints the URL and hook status.
10. Tests with node:test: adapter against fixtures (registry parse, subagent transcript record types and counts, agent_spawn linkage from the parent excerpt, drift on a corrupted line), paths extraction, state machine transitions and huddle detection using synthetic events.

VERIFY before you finish: `node --check` every file; `node --test tests/` passes; `node server.js --demo --no-open --port 7791` starts, `curl -s localhost:7791/api/health` returns JSON, `curl -sN localhost:7791/events | head -c 2000` shows a snapshot event; then stop it. Also run it in live mode against this machine: `node server.js --no-open --port 7792` and confirm /api/state lists the real sessions from ~/.claude/sessions (there are 3 live ones) and at least one agent with a model. Stop all servers you start.
